spacecore.label: P1
spacecore.explanation_en: This source-derived operational predicate restates Algorithm 1’s local-delivery branch. D=(α_d,γ_d) is the destination’s geospatial address, S=(α_s,γ_s) is the current satellite location in the paper’s affine spherical grid, and Δ_S is its coverage radius expressed in the same angular coordinate units. A destination inside both coverage intervals triggers paging and direct delivery; other packets enter the neighbor-selection branches. The geospatial destination stays fixed as satellites move, so the forwarding decision uses location rather than per-user orbital migration state. The square interval test is the algorithm’s grid abstraction of radio coverage.
spacecore.explanation_zh: 此 source-derived operational predicate 重述 Algorithm 1 的 local-delivery branch。D=(α_d,γ_d) 是目的 geospatial address，S=(α_s,γ_s) 是衛星在論文 affine spherical grid 的當下位置；Δ_S 是以相同角度座標單位表示的 coverage radius。目的位置落於兩個 coverage interval 時，執行 paging 與直接交付；其他封包進入 neighbor-selection branch。Geospatial destination 在衛星移動時維持固定，因此 forwarding 使用 location，而每用戶 orbital migration state 由 state-decoupling 機制處理。方形 interval test 是演算法的 radio coverage 網格抽象。
spacecore.source_anchor_en: §4.1, Algorithm 1, lines 1–2: stateless geospatial relaying; operational predicate transcribed from the algorithm.
spacecore.source_anchor_zh: §4.1、Algorithm 1 第 1–2 行：stateless geospatial relaying；此 predicate 由演算法轉寫。

leocc.label: P2
leocc.explanation_en: Equation (2) maintains two bandwidth estimates over the same reconfiguration-truncated sample window. dRate_t is the sender’s observed delivery rate in a consistent bandwidth unit; T, W_BW and t_last_Rcf use seconds or the implementation’s matching time unit. The aggressive estimate takes a maximum; the moderate estimate applies the specified Kalman filter. The latest detected reconfiguration clips the historical window, preventing samples from the previous network condition from influencing the new interval’s estimates. Kal denotes the specified filtering operation over the samples. The rate controller uses these parallel estimates in Dynamic Cruise and separately enters Reconfiguration Adaptation on an event.
leocc.explanation_zh: Equation (2) 在同一個由 reconfiguration 截斷的 sample window，維持兩項 bandwidth estimate。dRate_t 是 sender 觀察的 delivery rate，使用一致 bandwidth 單位；T、W_BW 與 t_last_Rcf 使用秒或實作中的一致時間單位。Aggressive estimate 取 maximum；moderate estimate 使用指定 Kalman filter。最新偵測的 reconfiguration 截斷 history，讓新 interval 的估計對應該段 network condition。Kal 表示對 samples 的 filtering operation。Rate controller 在 Dynamic Cruise 使用兩項估計，遇到 event 時另進入 Reconfiguration Adaptation。
leocc.source_anchor_en: §4.2.1, Equation (2): parallel reconfiguration-aware bottleneck-bandwidth estimators; notation shortened from the paper’s bBW subscripts.
leocc.source_anchor_zh: §4.2.1、Equation (2)：平行 reconfiguration-aware bottleneck-bandwidth estimator；此處縮短原文 bBW 下標。

deepspace.label: P3
deepspace.explanation_en: Equations (7) and (8) define the post-reconstruction quality checks used by the outlier retransmission path. I_in is the received low-resolution image; S downsamples the reconstructed high-resolution image I_recon; I_real is the stored original image. SSIM is structural similarity, HD is Hamming distance between binary locality-sensitive hashes, and wℓ is the image-size normalization stated by the paper. LRS and HSIM are dimensionless similarity scores. Reconstruction metadata carries the original hash and image dimensions to the cloud; a score below its configured threshold triggers retrieval of the retained original. These are concrete retransmission tests, while the thresholds and empirical downstream fidelity establish their operating scope.
deepspace.explanation_zh: Equations (7) 與 (8) 定義 outlier retransmission path 的重建品質檢查。I_in 是收到的 low-resolution image；S 將 high-resolution reconstructed image I_recon 下採樣；I_real 是保存的 original image。SSIM 是 structural similarity；HD 是 binary locality-sensitive hash 間的 Hamming distance；wℓ 是原文指定的 image-size normalization。LRS 與 HSIM 為 similarity score。Metadata 將原圖 hash 與 image dimensions 帶到 cloud；score 低於設定 threshold 時，擷取保留的 original。這些是具體 retransmission test，threshold 與實測 downstream fidelity 建立其運作範圍。
deepspace.source_anchor_en: §4.3, Equations (7)–(8), Outlier Retransmission; subsequent paragraph gives the threshold-trigger rule.
deepspace.source_anchor_zh: §4.3、Equations (7)–(8)，Outlier Retransmission；後續段落給出 threshold-trigger rule。

sate.label: P4
sate.latex: \begin{aligned}\max_{x}\quad&U=\sum_{f\in\mathcal F_t}\sum_{p\in\mathcal P_f}x_{fp}\\\mathrm{s.t.}\quad&\sum_f\sum_{p\in\mathcal P_f}\Phi_{pe}x_{fp}\le C_e\quad\forall e,\\&\sum_{f\in\mathcal F_n^{up}}\sum_p x_{fp}\le C_n^{up},\quad\sum_{f\in\mathcal F_n^{dn}}\sum_p x_{fp}\le C_n^{dn}\quad\forall n,\\&\sum_{p\in\mathcal P_f}x_{fp}\le d_f\quad\forall f,\qquad x_{fp}\ge0.\end{aligned}
sate.explanation_en: Appendix A Equation (2.a–f) maximizes admitted network throughput. x_fp allocates flow f to feasible path p; Φ_pe is one when p uses link e; C_e is its capacity; d_f is demand. F_n^up and F_n^dn denote the source/destination flow subsets used by the paper’s satellite uplink and downlink constraints. All x, C and d use consistent rate units, so U is aggregate rate. Link, access and demand limits are separate constraints. SaTE learns allocations from solver-generated labels, then trims overload to enforce feasibility (§3.3); measured throughput includes that correction. This formulation is a static snapshot TE target, with runtime topology and demand updating its inputs.
sate.explanation_zh: Appendix A Equation (2.a–f) 最大化 admitted network throughput。x_fp 配置 flow f 到 feasible path p；當 p 使用 link e 時 Φ_pe=1；C_e 是 capacity；d_f 是 demand。F_n^up 與 F_n^dn 表示原文 satellite uplink／downlink 限制的 source／destination flow subset。x、C 與 d 使用一致 rate 單位，因此 U 是 aggregate rate。Link、access 與 demand limit 各有 constraint。SaTE 從 solver label 學習 allocation，再於 §3.3 修剪 overload 以維持 feasibility；量測 throughput 包含此修正。此 formulation 是 snapshot TE target，runtime topology 與 demand 更新其輸入。
sate.source_anchor_en: Appendix A, Equation (2.a–f), PDF proceedings p911; §3.3 explains constraint trimming. F_n subsets restate the paper’s f↑n / f↓n notation.
sate.source_anchor_zh: Appendix A、Equation (2.a–f)，proceedings p911；§3.3 說明 constraint trimming。F_n subset 重述原文 f↑n／f↓n。

tinyleo.label: P5
tinyleo.latex: \min_{x}\|x\|_1\qquad\mathrm{s.t.}\quad A_t x\ge y_t\ \forall t\in\{1,\ldots,T_{max}\},\qquad x_j\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}
tinyleo.explanation_en: Equations (2)–(4) minimize constellation size subject to spatial demand coverage at every considered time. x_j is the satellite count assigned to candidate Earth-repeat ground track j; A_t(i,j) is the fractional coverage of geographic cell i by that candidate at time t; y_t is demand in the paper’s normalized satellite-capacity units. A_t x and y_t therefore share supply/demand units, while ||x||₁ is a count. T_max spans the least common multiple of the orbital repetition periods. The integer domain includes zero, matching the sparse allocation initialized in Algorithm 1. TinyLEO unfolds all times into one sparse matching problem and approximates this ILP using matching pursuit. This aggregate formulation couples its coverage constraints across the repetition horizon.
tinyleo.explanation_zh: Equations (2)–(4) 在各時間的 spatial demand coverage 限制下，最小化 constellation size。x_j 是配置給 candidate Earth-repeat ground track j 的 satellite count；A_t(i,j) 是該 candidate 在時間 t 對 geographic cell i 的 fractional coverage；y_t 使用原文 normalized satellite-capacity demand 單位。A_t x 與 y_t 因此共享 supply／demand 單位；||x||₁ 是 count。T_max 跨越 orbital repetition period 的最小公倍數。Integer domain 包含 zero，符合 Algorithm 1 的 sparse initialization。TinyLEO 將各時間展開為一項 sparse matching problem，透過 matching pursuit 近似此 ILP。
tinyleo.source_anchor_en: §4.1, Equations (2)–(4) and Algorithm 1; N in the source is written as nonnegative integers here to expose the initialized-zero domain.
tinyleo.source_anchor_zh: §4.1、Equations (2)–(4) 與 Algorithm 1；此處將原文 N 寫為含 zero 的整數集合，呈現 initialization domain。

sn2.label: P6
sn2.explanation_en: This source-derived operational invariant formalizes §4.3’s policy-homogeneity branch. U is the terminal’s validated location region, obtained from beam coverage and available navigation/calibration information; policy_f(x) is the roaming policy for service f at location x. If every candidate location has the same policy p, the satellite can select that policy using the region, then apply the service’s accuracy and trust checks. The equation concerns policy identification; Table 1 separately assigns service-specific spatial precision, including emergency-service requirements. U is a geographic set, p is a policy label, and the predicate carries logical units. The formulation explains how coarse network-oriented navigation can safely authorize common services while refined positioning serves the ambiguous branch.
sn2.explanation_zh: 此 source-derived operational invariant 將 §4.3 的 policy-homogeneity branch 形式化。U 是 terminal 經驗證的 location region，來自 beam coverage 與可用 navigation／calibration 資訊；policy_f(x) 是位置 x 的 service f roaming policy。若各 candidate location 具有相同 policy p，衛星可依 region 選擇該 policy，再執行 service 的 accuracy 與 trust check。此 equation 描述 policy identification；Table 1 另指定各 service 的 spatial precision，包含 emergency-service requirement。U 是地理集合，p 是 policy label，predicate 屬邏輯條件。這顯示 coarse network-oriented navigation 如何安全授權常見服務；位置 refinement 處理 policy ambiguity branch。
sn2.source_anchor_en: §4.3, Flexible Non-Blocking Authorization, Figure 15 and Table 1; source-derived invariant for the homogeneous-policy case, with a separate service-precision check.
sn2.source_anchor_zh: §4.3、Flexible Non-Blocking Authorization、Figure 15 與 Table 1；此 invariant 由 homogeneous-policy case 推導，另執行 service-precision check。

starcdn.label: P7
starcdn.explanation_en: This source-derived tiling identity formalizes §3.2’s repeating √L×√L content-bucket assignment for the grid examples L=4 and L=9. i and j index orbital-grid neighbors, c is a zero-indexed satellite color/bucket label, and h maps an object o to a bucket using the source’s consistent-hash partition; all indices are integer labels. Every q×q tile contains each bucket once. A terminal’s first-contact satellite routes to the selected bucket owner; on a cache miss, §3.3’s relayed fetch contacts a same-bucket inter-plane neighbor, countering orbital motion. The expression transcribes the grid construction and assumes integer q. It is a coloring mechanism, and the paper evaluates the cache redundancy versus fetch-latency tradeoff as L changes.
starcdn.explanation_zh: 此 source-derived tiling identity 將 §3.2 的重複 √L×√L content-bucket assignment 形式化，對應 L=4 與 L=9 的 grid example。i、j 是 orbital-grid neighbor index，c 是由 zero 開始的 satellite color／bucket label；h 依原文 consistent-hash partition，將 object o 映射至 bucket。各 index 是整數 label。每個 q×q tile 含各 bucket 一次。Terminal 的 first-contact satellite 將 request 送往 bucket owner；cache miss 時，§3.3 的 relayed fetch 接觸 same-bucket inter-plane neighbor，以 counter orbital motion。此 expression 轉寫 grid construction，假設 q 為整數。它是 coloring 機制；論文評估 L 改變時 cache redundancy 與 fetch latency 的 tradeoff。
starcdn.source_anchor_en: §3.2, satellite-specific consistent hashing and Figure 5; §3.3, relayed fetch. Source-derived zero-indexed tiling identity.
starcdn.source_anchor_zh: §3.2、satellite-specific consistent hashing 與 Figure 5；§3.3、relayed fetch。此式是 source-derived zero-indexed tiling identity。

commsar.label: P8
commsar.explanation_en: Equation (9) bounds the uncoded downlink symbol rate using waveform orthogonality. B is SAR chirp bandwidth in Hz, T_p is pulse duration in seconds, and f_PRF is pulse repetition frequency in pulses/s. The time–bandwidth product BT_p counts resolvable orthogonal symbol choices; log₂(BT_p) is the ideal bits per pulse, making R_down bit/s. The associated FFT frequency resolution is Δf=1/T_p Hz. For the paper’s B=600 MHz, T_p=15 μs and f_PRF=8 kHz, the ideal expression gives approximately 105.1 kbps. Practical modulation chooses an integer alphabet and includes synchronization, coding and impairment costs; the bound describes that SAR waveform substrate, distinct from an optical AI fabric.
commsar.explanation_zh: Equation (9) 依 waveform orthogonality 約束 uncoded downlink symbol rate。B 是 SAR chirp bandwidth（Hz）；T_p 是 pulse duration（秒）；f_PRF 是 pulse repetition frequency（pulses/s）。Time–bandwidth product BT_p 計算可解析 orthogonal symbol choice；log₂(BT_p) 是 ideal bits/pulse，因此 R_down 為 bit/s。FFT frequency resolution 為 Δf=1/T_p Hz。原文 B=600 MHz、T_p=15 μs、f_PRF=8 kHz，理想式約為 105.1 kbps。實際 modulation 選 integer alphabet，並納入 synchronization、coding 與 impairment cost；此 bound 描述 SAR waveform substrate。
commsar.source_anchor_en: §3.1, Equation (9), Downlink Data Rate Analysis; Equation (5) defines the cyclic-shift symbol waveform.
commsar.source_anchor_zh: §3.1、Equation (9)，Downlink Data Rate Analysis；Equation (5) 定義 cyclic-shift symbol waveform。

planet-iot.label: P9
planet-iot.latex: \begin{aligned}\min_{w_i\subseteq c_i}\ &\sum_{i=1}^{F}\left[\Delta\widehat T_i(w_i)+\sigma\frac{\widehat E_i(w_i)}{\widehat T_i(w_i)}\right]\\\mathrm{s.t.}\ &\frac{\sum_i\widehat p_i(w_i)\widehat T_i(w_i)}{\sum_i\widehat T_i(w_i)}\le\tau,\\&\widehat T_i(w_i)=R|w_i|\widehat\pi_i(w_i).\end{aligned}
planet-iot.explanation_en: Appendix G.2 Equation (2) chooses radio-on windows w_i inside F predicted contacts c_i. R is bit/s; |w_i| is seconds; π̂_i is Beacon-reception probability, so T̂_i is expected delivered bits. ΔT̂_i is normalized throughput loss relative to the full contact. Ê_i is modeled joules, making Ê_i/T̂_i joules/bit. p̂_i predicts long-tail delivery probability; the weighted constraint limits the fraction of expected delivered bits experiencing long-tail latency to τ. The objective combines throughput and energy through the paper’s sensitivity weight σ; numerical scaling of σ must be retained because it mixes normalized loss with energy per bit. The ratio uses schedules with positive delivered volume. Candidate windows are finite transmission-slot selections; measured Beacon traces calibrate the prediction model.
planet-iot.explanation_zh: Appendix G.2 Equation (2) 在 F 個 predicted contact c_i 內，選擇 radio-on window w_i。R 為 bit/s；|w_i| 是秒；π̂_i 是 Beacon-reception probability，因此 T̂_i 是 expected delivered bits。ΔT̂_i 是相對 full contact 的 normalized throughput loss。Ê_i 是 modeled joules，因此 Ê_i／T̂_i 是 joules/bit。p̂_i 預測 long-tail delivery probability；weighted constraint 限制 expected delivered bits 中 long-tail latency 比例至 τ。Objective 透過原文 sensitivity weight σ 結合 throughput 與 energy；因 normalized loss 與 energy/bit 同時計入，應保留 σ 的 numerical scaling。Ratio 使用 delivered volume 為正的 schedule。Candidate window 是有限 transmission-slot selection；Beacon trace 校準 prediction model。
planet-iot.source_anchor_en: Appendix G.2.1–G.2.2, Equation (2), DtS Flow Control; throughput, energy and long-tail definitions immediately precede the objective.
planet-iot.source_anchor_zh: Appendix G.2.1–G.2.2、Equation (2)，DtS Flow Control；objective 前段定義 throughput、energy 與 long-tail。

dissecting-starlink.label: P10
dissecting-starlink.explanation_en: This measurement identity transcribes Algorithm 1. Synchronized send/receive timestamps use seconds; d_min is minimum observed one-way delay; d̂_p^q estimates a received packet’s queue sojourn in seconds. Enqueue events at t_tx add one packet, dequeue events at t_rx−d_min remove one, and estimated head-drop events remove one at the interpolated drop time. The running sum Q̂ is packets. The source restricts baseline-based reconstruction primarily to short measurements within one reconfiguration interval, documents a 3–5 ms downlink queue-arrival offset, and discusses clock synchronization, cross traffic and loss attribution. Therefore this is an estimator conditioned on the stated baseline and head-drop model; it exposes queue dynamics through calibrated endpoint observations.
dissecting-starlink.explanation_zh: 此 measurement identity 轉寫 Algorithm 1。同步 send／receive timestamp 使用秒；d_min 是 minimum observed one-way delay；d̂_p^q 估計收到封包的 queue sojourn（秒）。t_tx 的 enqueue event 加一個 packet；t_rx−d_min 的 dequeue event 減一個 packet；估計 head-drop event 在 interpolated drop time 減一個 packet。Running sum Q̂ 使用 packets。原文主要在單一 reconfiguration interval 內的短量測進行 baseline-based reconstruction，記錄 downlink queue-arrival 的 3–5 ms offset，並討論 clock synchronization、cross traffic 與 loss attribution。此 estimator 因此依賴指定 baseline 與 head-drop model，透過校準 endpoint observation 呈現 queue dynamics。
dissecting-starlink.source_anchor_en: §3.3, Algorithm 1, lines 2–19; following limitations paragraph specifies the reconstruction assumptions and timing offsets.
dissecting-starlink.source_anchor_zh: §3.3、Algorithm 1 第 2–19 行；後續 limitations 段落指定 reconstruction 假設與 timing offset。

coorbit.label: P11
coorbit.explanation_en: Equation (1) compares current and reference tile embeddings; §3.2 then sets the per-image threshold to mean plus standard deviation of tile distances. z_i^t and z_i^{t−1} are embeddings of the same geographic tile at two observation times, with positive vector norms; d_i is a dimensionless cosine distance. μ_d and σ_d are computed across that image’s tile distances. Tiles above T remain for downlink; the other branch marks redundancy and discards the tile. This is a semantic-change filter calibrated on the paper’s imagery, with compact references propagated through scheduled ground contacts. Embedding distance and empirical change detection establish retention quality; the equation itself defines the decision rule.
coorbit.explanation_zh: Equation (1) 比較 current 與 reference tile embedding；§3.2 再將 per-image threshold 設為 tile distance 的 mean 加 standard deviation。z_i^t 與 z_i^{t−1} 是相同 geographic tile 於兩個 observation time 的 embedding，vector norm 為正；d_i 是 cosine distance。μ_d 與 σ_d 由該 image 的 tile distances 計算。高於 T 的 tile 保留供 downlink；另一 branch 標記 redundancy 並丟棄 tile。此 semantic-change filter 依原文 imagery 校準，compact reference 透過 scheduled ground contact 傳遞。Embedding distance 與實測 change detection 建立 retention quality；equation 本身定義 decision rule。
coorbit.source_anchor_en: §3.2, Equation (1), and the immediately following adaptive-thresholding paragraph.
coorbit.source_anchor_zh: §3.2、Equation (1) 與緊接的 adaptive-thresholding 段落。

orbitalbrain.label: P12
orbitalbrain.explanation_en: Equation (1) is the performance profiler’s local-compute utility. n_comp_s predicts the number of samples processed in the upcoming scheduling window; η_s counts windows since the satellite’s latest model aggregation; D_s is the previous window’s training sample set; Loss(d) is the dimensionless local training loss. The decay exponent a is positive, with a=1 in the reported experiments. The score scales expected work by a square-root loss/staleness factor, so it is a heuristic utility with sample-scaled square-root-loss units. It ranks prospective computation in the framework’s compute/aggregation/data-transfer choices. Training convergence is measured by the experiment; the utility is the source’s operational proxy. Appendix A separately states the general allocation problem and physical constraints in Equations (6)–(9).
orbitalbrain.explanation_zh: Equation (1) 是 performance profiler 的 local-compute utility。n_comp_s 預測下一 scheduling window 處理的 sample count；η_s 計算最近 model aggregation 後經過的 window；D_s 是上一 window 的 training sample set；Loss(d) 是 local training loss。Decay exponent a 為正，原文實驗採 a=1。Score 將 expected work 乘以 square-root loss／staleness factor，因此是 sample-scaled square-root-loss 單位的 heuristic utility。它在 compute／aggregation／data-transfer 決策中排序 prospective computation。Training convergence 由實驗量測；utility 是原文 operational proxy。Appendix A 另於 Equations (6)–(9) 提出 general allocation problem 與 physical constraint。
orbitalbrain.source_anchor_en: §3.1, Equation (1), performance profiler, PDF p9; Appendix A Equations (6)–(9) give the broader formulation.
orbitalbrain.source_anchor_zh: §3.1、Equation (1)，performance profiler，PDF p9；Appendix A Equations (6)–(9) 提供較廣 formulation。

taccl.label: P13
taccl.explanation_en: Appendix B.1 Equations (1), (2), (4), (5) and (6) define a routing-stage makespan objective with availability, causality and aggregate link-time bounds. c is a data chunk; u,v,r are GPU ranks; post is the collective postcondition; y_cuv indicates whether the chunk uses a link. start, send, lat and T use consistent time units. lat=α+β is the source’s single-chunk transfer cost for the profiled link. The equality connects a used transfer to chunk arrival; the lower bound sums transfer costs on each link. This routing stage relaxes detailed overlap/order bandwidth constraints, yielding paths and lower-bound timing; TACCL’s later ordering and exact scheduling stage enforces the concrete schedule. The displayed subset preserves that stage boundary.
taccl.explanation_zh: Appendix B.1 Equations (1)、(2)、(4)、(5)、(6) 定義 routing-stage makespan objective，包含 availability、causality 與 aggregate link-time bound。c 是 data chunk；u、v、r 是 GPU rank；post 是 collective postcondition；y_cuv 表示 chunk 使用 link。start、send、lat 與 T 使用一致時間單位。lat=α+β 是 profiled link 的 single-chunk transfer cost。Equality 將使用中的 transfer 連到 chunk arrival；lower bound 對各 link 累加 transfer cost。Routing stage 對詳細 overlap／order bandwidth constraint 採 relaxed model，產生 path 與 lower-bound timing；後續 ordering 與 exact scheduling stage 執行具體 schedule。此 constraint subset 保留該 stage boundary。
taccl.source_anchor_en: Appendix B.1, Equations (1), (2), (4), (5), (6), proceedings p610; y is a shortened alias for is_sent and T for time.
taccl.source_anchor_zh: Appendix B.1、Equations (1)、(2)、(4)、(5)、(6)，proceedings p610；y 縮寫 is_sent，T 縮寫 time。

topoopt.label: P14
topoopt.latex: d_A=\max\left(1,\left\lceil d\frac{\sum T_A}{\sum T_A+\sum T_{MP}}\right\rceil\right),\qquad d_{MP}=d-d_A,\qquad T_{MP}[e]\leftarrow T_{MP}[e]/2
topoopt.explanation_en: Algorithm 1 lines 2–3 distributes server degree d between the AllReduce sub-topology and model-parallel (MP) sub-topology using an upward-rounded transfer-volume fraction, reserving at least one AllReduce degree. T_A and T_MP use the same volume units, so the ratio is dimensionless and d_A/d_MP are integer port counts. The construction assumes positive total traffic and d≥1. The MP branch uses successive maximum-weight matchings; line 17 halves a selected edge’s demand weight to create diminishing returns and diversify subsequent matchings. This is the paper’s topology heuristic inside an alternating topology/parallelization search. Link degree and transfer-weight updates are operational controls; end-to-end iteration time evaluates the resulting joint choice.
topoopt.explanation_zh: Algorithm 1 第 2–3 行依向上取整的 transfer volume 比例，將 server degree d 分配給 AllReduce 與 model-parallel（MP）sub-topology，至少保留一個 AllReduce degree。T_A 與 T_MP 使用相同 volume 單位，因此 ratio 為比例，d_A／d_MP 是整數 port count。Construction 假設 total traffic 為正且 d≥1。MP branch 反覆使用 maximum-weight matching；第 17 行將選定 edge demand weight 除以二，形成 diminishing return 並促進後續 matching 多樣性。此 heuristic 位於 alternating topology／parallelization search。Link degree 與 transfer-weight update 是 operational control；end-to-end iteration time 評估 joint choice。
topoopt.source_anchor_en: §4.2, Algorithm 1 lines 2–3 and 13–17, proceedings p744; algorithmic pseudocode supplies the degree-allocation identity.
topoopt.source_anchor_zh: §4.2、Algorithm 1 第 2–3 與 13–17 行，proceedings p744；degree allocation 來自 algorithmic pseudocode。

cosmac.label: P15
cosmac.explanation_en: Equation (1) sets an IoT device’s randomized transmission probability using the estimated device populations in its K overlapping satellite footprints. The denominator deliberately sums footprint populations, so an overlap device contributes contention across several footprints; it represents overlap-weighted load. α is the dynamically tuned flow-control parameter broadcast through Beacon feedback. Population counts and α yield a dimensionless probability, with operational tuning keeping p_d within its probability domain. §4.3 uses aggregate under-/over-utilization feedback to adjust α. The model controls contention on sparse RF contacts, while its measured throughput/fairness evaluates the overlap approximation and the feedback loop.
cosmac.explanation_zh: Equation (1) 依 IoT device 所在 K 個 overlapping satellite footprint 的 estimated device population，設定 randomized transmission probability。Denominator 累加各 footprint population，使 overlap device 對多個 footprint 的 contention 共同計入，代表 overlap-weighted load。α 是由 Beacon feedback 動態調整的 flow-control parameter。Population count 與 α 產生 probability，operational tuning 將 p_d 維持於 probability domain。§4.3 依 aggregate under／over-utilization feedback 調整 α。此 model 控制 sparse RF contact 的 contention；實測 throughput／fairness 評估 overlap approximation 與 feedback loop。
cosmac.source_anchor_en: §4.2, Equation (1); §4.3 specifies aggregate Beacon flow-control feedback.
cosmac.source_anchor_zh: §4.2、Equation (1)；§4.3 指定 aggregate Beacon flow-control feedback。
